checks.method: Capture drive-inhibit output through USB power-up, MCU reset and removal of each permit

checks.required_input: assembled vehicle board, current-limited power supply, and logic traces
checks.blocked_action: record measured startup and stop behaviour before the first course run

checks.method: Verify exact 1525 model and Hall wiring against manufacturer evidence or pin and phase measurements
checks.pass_condition: Supply, logic levels, pin order and valid Hall sequence map to the selected drive stage
checks.required_input: manufacturer pinout and electrical limits, plus Hall/phase evidence for the sample

checks.method: Check phase and pack current, speed and temperature at the reference load
checks.pass_condition: Assess 21200 rpm at the 3.5:1 reference and 1.4–1.9 mNm with the verified rail and component limits
checks.required_input: fixture CSV with speed, torque, supply voltage, phase and pack currents, temperatures, and duration
checks.notes: This is a screening reference from drive-performance.md; it is separate from on-course acceptance.

checks.method: Check VZ mechanical envelope using dimensions from a complete chassis
